info.name: Digify ERP — PAY Payroll Group Management
info.description:
CRUD APIs for PAY.PAYROLL_GROUPS_PKG using PAY.V_PAYROLL_GROUPS for reads.

Mutations commit only when x_success = 'Y'.

Set {{baseUrl}}, {{jwt}}, and {{payroll_group_guid}} in collection variables.

Base path: /api/pay/payroll-groups
